headlines.description: — LaMelo Ball had 23 points and nine assists, Brandon Miller added 20 points and the Charlotte Hornets pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat the Washington Wizards 126-109 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: LaMelo Ball scores 23, Hornets use strong fourth quarter to pull away from Wizards 126-109

headlines.description: — Michael Porter Jr. scored 28 points, Egor Demin added 20 and the Brooklyn Nets beat the Philadelphia 76ers 114-106 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter scores 28 points, Nets beat 76ers 114-106 for third win in four games

headlines.description: — Josh Giddey had 19 points, 15 assists and 11 rebounds, Coby White hit a tiebreaking free throw with 1.9 seconds left, and the Chicago Bulls rallied for their fourth straight victory, 126-123 over the Atlanta Hawks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giddey and White help Bulls rally from late 10-point deficit to beat Hawks 126-123

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 27 points, Sam Merrill added 22 and the Cleveland Cavaliers pulled away in the second half for a 141-118 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell and Sam Merrill propel Cavaliers to 141-118 victory over Pelicans

headlines.description: — Kevin Porter Jr. scored 24 points, Ryan Rollins had 23 and the Milwaukee Bucks, playing their seventh consecutive game without the injured Giannis Antetokounmpo, beat the Indiana Pacers 111-94 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter, Rollins guide Bucks past Pacers 111-94

headlines.description: — Scottie Barnes scored 27 points and grabbed eight rebounds, and the Toronto Raptors beat the reeling Miami Heat 112-91 on Tuesday night in the final pre-Christmas game for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barnes scores 27, Raptors ease past reeling Heat 112-91. It's Miami's 9th loss in an 11-game span

headlines.description: — Cooper Flagg had 33 points, nine rebounds and nine assists, and Anthony Davis had 31 points and nine rebounds as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Denver Nuggets 131-130 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flagg scores 33 points, Davis adds 31 as Mavericks beat Nuggets 131-130

events.name: New York Knicks at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 38 points to help the Minnesota Timberwolves beat former teammate Karl-Anthony Towns for the first time and hold off the New York Knicks 115-104 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves beat Towns for first time as Edwards scores 38 points in 115-104 win over Knicks

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Keldon Johnson had 25 points, Stephon Castle added 24 and the San Antonio Spurs stormed past Oklahoma City 130-110 on Tuesday night, winning their seventh straight game and beating the Thunder for the second time in 11 days.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs beat Thunder for second time in 11 days, storming to 130-110 victory behind Johnson, Castle

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Dillon Brooks scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 21 and the Phoenix Suns pulled away in the second half to beat the Los Angeles Lakers 132-108 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dillon Brooks scores 25, Suns dominate Luka-less Lakers for a 132-108 victory

headlines.description: — Santi Aldama made seven 3-pointers and scored a career-high 37 points to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 137-128 victory over the Utah Jazz on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Santi Aldama scores a career-high 37 points, with 7 3-pointers, to lead the Grizzlies past the Jazz

events.name: Orlando Magic at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Desmond Bane scored 23 points, Anthony Black added 22 and the Orlando Magic turned away Portland's comeback attempt Tuesday night for a 110-106 victory over the Trail Blazers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bane's work on both ends helps Magic hold off Trail Blazers, 110-106

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham had 23 points and 14 assists, Jalen Duren had 23 points and 12 rebounds, and the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons beat the Sacramento Kings 136-127 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cunningham, Duren and Harris lead East-best Pistons to 136-127 win over Kings

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard scored 41 points and James Harden added 29 as the Los Angeles Clippers beat the Houston Rockets 128-108 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leonard's 41-point game powers Clippers to a 128-108 victory over the Rockets
